surface_name: Lambda Node.js 20 and later, CA certificates
title: Lambda cannot connect to RDS over TLS after upgrading from Node.js 18 to Node.js 20 or later
symptoms: Error: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN from pg, mysql2, or Prisma when ssl is on
Same code connects fine on nodejs18.x
cause: Up to Node.js 18, Lambda loaded Amazon CA certificates, including the RDS ones, automatically. From Node.js 20 it no longer does, so the RDS server chain is not trusted.
fix: Bundle the RDS certificate bundle for your Region and point NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS at it, or point it at the Amazon CA file the runtime ships. Pass certificate contents, not a path, when you hand a CA to the driver yourself.
apply:
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name my-fn \
  --environment 'Variables={NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/var/runtime/ca-cert.pem}'
# faster cold starts: ship certificates/rds.pem and use /var/task/certificates/rds.pem
affected: Lambda nodejs20.x and every later Node.js runtime; zip and container deployments
